messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment order can only be charged to an account of type CTE (current), AHO (savings) or VIR (virtual). Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "@i_tipo_cuenta not in ('CTE','AHO','VIR')",
  "action": "Set error 50001 and message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO', then stop through the error exit. No debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Savings account accepted\n Given an order paid from an account of type 'AHO'\n When the payment is processed\n Then the account type check passes and processing continues",
   "Scenario: Unsupported account type rejected\n Given an account type 'PLZ'\n When the payment is processed\n Then error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' is returned and nothing is debited"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Order must exist and be pending",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The payment order must exist for the company and be in pending state 'P'. A missing order gives error 50002 and an order in any other state gives error 50003.",
  "condition": "No row in pg_orden for ord_numero=@i_orden and ord_empresa=@i_empresa -> 50002; else ord_estado <> 'P' -> 50003",
  "action": "Reject with 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' (50002) or 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' (50003); otherwise continue.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Pending order accepted\n Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'P'\n When the payment is processed\n Then processing continues",
   "Scenario: Order not found\n Given no order 9999 for company 7\n When the payment is processed\n Then error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' is returned",
   "Scenario: Order already paid\n Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'A'\n When the payment is processed\n Then error 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' is returned"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Tariff lookup: company tariff first, else general service tariff",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "The commission tariff comes from the company-specific tariff table, with its flag for charging the commission separately. If the company has no tariff for the service, the general service tariff is used and the commission is never separate. A missing tariff counts as 0.",
  "condition": "Company tariff row exists for (@i_empresa,@i_servicio) -> use tar_valor and tar_separada; else use srv_tarifa with separada='N'; if the tariff is null -> 0",
  "action": "Set @w_tarifa and @w_separada accordingly.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Company tariff present\n Given company 7 has a tariff of 5.0000 with separada 'S' for service 'PROV'\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then the tariff is 5.0000 and the commission is separate",
   "Scenario: Fallback to general tariff\n Given company 7 has no tariff for 'PROV' and the service tariff is 3.0000\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then the tariff is 3.0000 and separada is 'N'",
   "Scenario: No tariff anywhere\n Given neither table gives a tariff\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then the tariff is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Commission by channel; payroll is free",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Orders from the WEB channel pay half the tariff, rounded to 2 decimals. Other channels pay the full tariff. The NOMINA (payroll) service never pays commission, whatever the channel.",
  "condition": "@i_canal = 'WEB' -> comision = round(tarifa/2, 2); else comision = tarifa; then @i_servicio = 'NOMINA' -> comision = 0",
  "action": "Set @w_comision.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Web channel half tariff\n Given tariff 5.00, channel 'WEB', service 'PROV'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 2.50",
   "Scenario: Branch channel full tariff\n Given tariff 5.00, channel 'OFI', service 'PROV'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 5.00",
   "Scenario: Payroll is free\n Given tariff 5.00, channel 'OFI', service 'NOMINA'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Total to debit includes the commission unless charged separately",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The first debit equals the order value plus the commission. If the commission is flagged as separate ('S'), the first debit is only the order value.",
  "condition": "@w_separada = 'S' -> total = @i_valor; else total = @i_valor + @w_comision",
  "action": "Set @w_total.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included\n Given value 100.00, commission 2.50, separada 'N'\n When the total is calculated\n Then the total is 102.50",
   "Scenario: Commission separate\n Given value 100.00, commission 2.50, separada 'S'\n When the total is calculated\n Then the total is 100.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Sufficient funds: virtual accounts cannot overdraw, others up to 100.00",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A virtual (VIR) account needs a balance at least equal to the total to debit. Current and savings accounts may overdraw by up to 100.00. Otherwise the payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'.",
  "condition": "(tipo='VIR' and saldo < total) or (tipo<>'VIR' and saldo + 100.00 < total)",
  "action": "Set error 50004 and message 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES', then stop. No debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Virtual account exact balance\n Given VIR account with balance 102.50 and total 102.50\n When funds are checked\n Then the payment proceeds",
   "Scenario: Virtual account short\n Given VIR account with balance 100.00 and total 102.50\n When funds are checked\n Then error 50004 is returned",
   "Scenario: Savings account within overdraft\n Given AHO account with balance 10.00 and total 105.00\n When funds are checked\n Then the payment proceeds because 110.00 >= 105.00",
   "Scenario: Savings account beyond overdraft\n Given AHO account with balance 0.00 and total 100.01\n When funds are checked\n Then error 50004 is returned"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Debit of the account and separate commission movement, undone on failure",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Inside one transaction the account is debited for the total with reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and the movement number is returned. If the commission is separate and greater than 0, a second movement 'COMISION PAGO' debits the commission. A failure in either debit undoes the transaction and returns error 50005 (debit) or 50006 (commission).",
  "condition": "sp_debito returns <> 0 or @@error <> 0 -> 50005; separada='S' and comision > 0 and second sp_debito returns <> 0 -> 50006",
  "action": "Debit @w_total; if separada='S' and comision>0, debit @w_comision. On failure rollback and set the error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included in one movement\n Given total 102.50 and separada 'N'\n When the debit runs\n Then one movement 'PAGO ORDEN' for 102.50 is created",
   "Scenario: Separate commission\n Given value 100.00, commission 2.50, separada 'S'\n When the debit runs\n Then movement 'PAGO ORDEN' for 100.00 and movement 'COMISION PAGO' for 2.50 are created",
   "Scenario: Separate commission with zero commission (NOMINA)\n Given separada 'S' and commission 0\n When the debit runs\n Then no second movement is created",
   "Scenario: Commission debit fails\n Given the second debit returns non-zero\n When the debit runs\n Then the transaction is rolled back and error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION' is returned"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Order is marked paid with processing date and commission",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "After the debits succeed, the order moves from pending to paid ('A') with the payment date set to the processing date and the commission charged recorded. If the update fails or touches no row, everything is undone and error 50007 is returned. Otherwise the result is 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "condition": "update of pg_orden gives @@error <> 0 or rowcount = 0 -> rollback, 50007; else commit",
  "action": "Set ord_estado='A', ord_fecha_pago=@i_fecha_proceso, ord_comision=@w_comision; commit; message 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful payment\n Given a pending order 1001, commission 2.50, processing date 2024-05-10\n When the debits succeed\n Then the order is 'A', paid on 2024-05-10 with commission 2.50 and the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'",
   "Scenario: Update touches no row\n Given the order update affects 0 rows\n When the update is evaluated\n Then the transaction is rolled back, including the debits, and error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' is returned"
  ]
 }
]

{"stories": [
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Validate the account type and the payment order before paying",
"narrative": "As a treasury operator, I want the payment to be accepted only when the account type is allowed and the order exists and is pending, so that no money is debited for invalid or already processed orders.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario Outline: Permitted account type accepted
  Given an order paid from an account of type "<tipo>"
  When the payment is processed
  Then the account type check passes and processing continues
  Examples:
    | tipo |
    | CTE  |
    | AHO  |
    | VIR  |",
"Scenario: Unsupported account type rejected
  Given an order paid from an account of type 'PLZ'
  When the payment is processed
  Then error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' is returned
  And nothing is debited",
"Scenario: Pending order accepted
  Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'P'
  When the payment is processed
  Then processing continues",
"Scenario: Order not found
  Given no order 9999 exists for company 7
  When the payment is processed
  Then error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' is returned",
"Scenario: Order already paid
  Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'A'
  When the payment is processed
  Then error 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' is returned"
],
"links": ["RULE-001", "RULE-002"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Calculate the commission and the total to debit",
"narrative": "As a treasury operator, I want the commission to be determined from the applicable tariff, channel and service, so that the customer is charged the correct total for the payment.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Company tariff present
  Given company 7 has a tariff of 5.0000 with separada 'S' for service 'PROV'
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 5.0000
  And the commission is charged separately",
"Scenario: Fallback to general service tariff
  Given company 7 has no tariff for service 'PROV'
  And the general service tariff is 3.0000
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 3.0000
  And separada is 'N'",
"Scenario: No tariff anywhere
  Given neither the company tariff table nor the service gives a tariff
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 0",
"Scenario: Web channel pays half the tariff
  Given tariff 5.00, channel 'WEB' and service 'PROV'
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is 2.50",
"Scenario: Branch channel pays the full tariff
  Given tariff 5.00, channel 'OFI' and service 'PROV'
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is 5.00",
"Scenario: Payroll service is free
  Given tariff 5.00, channel 'OFI' and service 'NOMINA'
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is 0",
"Scenario: Commission included in the total
  Given order value 100.00, commission 2.50 and separada 'N'
  When the total to debit is calculated
  Then the total is 102.50",
"Scenario: Separate commission excluded from the total
  Given order value 100.00, commission 2.50 and separada 'S'
  When the total to debit is calculated
  Then the total is 100.00"
],
"links": ["RULE-003", "RULE-004", "RULE-005"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Check that the account has sufficient funds",
"narrative": "As a treasury operator, I want the available funds to be checked according to the account type, so that virtual accounts never overdraw and other accounts overdraw by no more than 100.00.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Virtual account with exact balance
  Given a VIR account with balance 102.50 and a total to debit of 102.50
  When funds are checked
  Then the payment proceeds",
"Scenario: Virtual account with insufficient balance
  Given a VIR account with balance 100.00 and a total to debit of 102.50
  When funds are checked
  Then error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' is returned
  And nothing is debited",
"Scenario: Savings account within the overdraft limit
  Given an AHO account with balance 10.00 and a total to debit of 105.00
  When funds are checked
  Then the payment proceeds because 110.00 is at least 105.00",
"Scenario: Savings account beyond the overdraft limit
  Given an AHO account with balance 0.00 and a total to debit of 100.01
  When funds are checked
  Then error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' is returned"
],
"links": ["RULE-006"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Debit the account and mark the order as paid in a single transaction",
"narrative": "As a treasury operator, I want the debits and the order status update to succeed or fail together, so that accounts and orders are never left inconsistent.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Commission included in one movement
  Given a total to debit of 102.50 and separada 'N'
  When the debit runs
  Then one movement 'PAGO ORDEN' for 102.50 is created",
"Scenario: Separate commission creates a second movement
  Given order value 100.00, commission 2.50 and separada 'S'
  When the debit runs
  Then a movement 'PAGO ORDEN' for 100.00 is created
  And a movement 'COMISION PAGO' for 2.50 is created",
"Scenario: Separate commission of zero creates no second movement
  Given separada 'S' and commission 0 for a NOMINA order
  When the debit runs
  Then no 'COMISION PAGO' movement is created",
"Scenario: Account debit fails
  Given the first debit returns a non-zero result
  When the debit runs
  Then the transaction is rolled back
  And error 50005 is returned",
"Scenario: Commission debit fails
  Given the second debit returns a non-zero result
  When the debit runs
  Then the transaction is rolled back
  And error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION' is returned",
"Scenario: Successful payment marks the order as paid
  Given pending order 1001, commission 2.50 and processing date 2024-05-10
  When the debits succeed
  Then the order state is 'A' with payment date 2024-05-10 and commission 2.50
  And the transaction is committed
  And the message 'PAGO REALIZADO' is returned",
"Scenario: Order update touches no row
  Given the order update affects 0 rows
  When the update is evaluated
  Then the transaction is rolled back including the debits
  And error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' is returned"
],
"links": ["RULE-007", "RULE-008"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 8
}
]}
